reviews.title: Unlawful & Unethical Renewal
reviews.text: I free-trialed and cancelled this app in 2022. The app auto-renewed four days ago with zero notice. This is illegal in California (where I live); renewals require advance notice giving users time to cancel. The company made an “exception” and returned a portion of the charge. Awaiting return of the rest. Californians - know your rights. These sleazy tactics are subject to (and barred by!) California Business & Professions Code § 17601.

reviews.title: Beware of subscription
reviews.text:
Apparently 8 months ago I downloaded this app and tried the free trial. I did not like it, so I deleted the app and made sure I was no longer subscribed via the my App Store app subscription tab. 6 months later I get billed over $150 for a renewal of a 6-month subscription. This is a major applications flaw. When I reached out to customer service, they were unwilling to provide a refund. Even after confirming I should be able to see that I have a current subscription in my App Store subscriptions tab. 
I’m sure this app is great, just beware of this flaw and loosing your money. They will not refund you nor make it right.
